headline: Earnings per share dip from last quarter but beat last year
summary_short: Karooooo's latest quarterly EPS was 9.28, down about 3% from 9.53 in the prior quarter and up about 18% from 7.88 a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of 9.28 compares with 9.53 last quarter and 7.88 a year ago. Karooooo reports in South African rand; the shard labels the latest value USD but the priors ZAR, so the currency of the latest figure is uncertain.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Two searches did not surface the October 2026 results release. Currency label on the latest EPS is inconsistent in the shard, so treat the q/q and y/y deltas as approximate.
